title: profinet-mrp: add support for MRP-Interconnection
description:
The Profinet Wireshark dissector currently supports MRP but lacks support
for MRP-Interconnection, which is essential for communication between MRP rings.
This update extends the dissector by implementing a dissection function
for each MRP-Interconnection type.
